heard: 1 Mishalemiah is lying clear, firstborn Zechariah stands here. 2 Jedeel is a second name, Zebediah takes the third claim. 3 Jethaniel, the fourth in life, the vitical gatekeeper, shines. Standing at the door so wide Serving at the Lord's house inside Guarding the threshold with care David's ear a faithful share With Jaziel and others there in the world
